question: In a velocity selector, the electric field is $E$ and the magnetic field is $B$. The device selects particles of speed $v_0 = E/B$. If a particle enters this region with speed $2v_0$, analyze the direction of the net force acting on it (assume $q>0$).

options.B: Net force is in the direction of the Electric Force ($F_E$).
options.C: Net force is in the direction of the Magnetic Force ($F_B$).
options.D: Net force is perpendicular to both fields but opposite to velocity.
